description: This file contains the implementation of the Login feature for the Users module, including request validation, handling login requests, verifying user credentials, and generating a JWT token.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user login credentials, including email and password.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating user login data, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class ensuring the login command contains non-null, non-empty email and password.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handler class for processing login commands, verifying user credentials, and generating JWT tokens.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes a login command, validates credentials, and returns a user envelope with a JWT token.
